flame-orange.$description: Flame Orange — Orange outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges.

ink.$description: Ink — Primary action buttons, headlines, body text, primary borders — warm near-black replaces pure black for a softer, editorial feel

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, button text on dark fills, card surfaces — the dominant background

bone.$description: Bone — Card backgrounds, subtle surface elevation above the white canvas, link/button ghost states

pebble.$description: Pebble — Nested surface backgrounds, secondary card layers, muted button backgrounds

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary body text, muted borders, description copy — warm gray for paragraph content

stone.$description: Stone — Tertiary text, placeholder text, inactive labels, subtle borders

ash.$description: Ash — Disabled states, very muted helper text, subtle dividers

true-black.$description: True Black — SVG icon fills, sharp borders where maximum contrast is needed, logo marks

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

general-sans-variable.$description: All display headlines, section headings, card titles, button labels, and emphasis text. Weight 700 is the single weight used — GitBook leans into geometric bold for its editorial authority. Negative tracking tightens at scale: -0.04em at 55px, -0.03em at 45px, -0.02em at 32px. This is the primary visual identity font.

general-sans.$description: Lead paragraph and subheading body copy. Weight 500 (medium) is heavier than typical body text — this is the descriptive copy directly under headlines, giving it subtle emphasis without crossing into heading territory.

inter.$description: Body text, paragraph copy, table data, dense information areas, and any secondary UI text. Inter is the workhorse — used wherever content density matters. Open-source, system-fallback friendly.

geist-mono.$description: Code snippets, technical labels, keyboard shortcuts, and monospaced data. Weight 600 gives code blocks presence against the Inter body.

general-sans-variable-variable-bold.$description: General Sans Variable Variable Bold — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

space-mono.$description: Space Mono — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
